g.text: Retained Sentinel-2 observed-pixel distributions (5th–95th whiskers; median and IQR)

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Boxes describe spatial pixel distributions, not uncertainty intervals. Per-pixel QA validity is retained; SCL clear classes 4/5/6 are summarized in observation_support.csv. No lake polygon or registered lake ROI is available.
